paper_vs_reality.claim: Data can be queried, browsed, downloaded and accessed (per article's data availability statement)
paper_vs_reality.observed: Browsing/manifest access confirmed working; actual per-file download via downloadCopy.jsp returned HTTP 404 on every attempt

risks: Core per-slice/per-gene result files (deconvolution, SVG, GSVA, cell-cell communication) could not be downloaded or schema-verified due to a reproducible server-side 404 error on the site's own download endpoint
No site-level license statement independent of the journal article was found; NC restriction from the article may or may not formally apply to the database content itself
Primary/foreign keys are custom cancer-type + slice IDs rather than standard BioThings identifiers; gene-level identifiers are expected only inside the unretrieved result files
A meaningful portion of linked content (raw scRNA-seq count files) may be redundant with existing GEO-derived resources rather than novel to BioThings
